_comment: Replay fixtures for tools.py, used when TOOLS_MODE=replay (the default).
Each tool has an optional 'exact' map (normalised argument -> result) and a
'default' that is served on a miss, so a run never depends on the live web.

default.title: City guide: what to see, hours and prices
default.snippet: The old-town market hall opens at 10:00. Museum general admission is 500 units. The observation deck is outdoor-only and closes in bad weather.

default.title: Transit day-pass: coverage and cost
default.snippet: A single day-pass covers metro, tram and the airport shuttle. Valid until midnight on the day of first use.

default.title: Seven-day forecast
default.snippet: Heavy rain expected through the day, easing after 19:00. Outdoor attractions may close early.

default.text: City guide. The covered market hall is open 10:00-20:00 daily and has around forty stalls. The national museum charges 500 units for general admission, with last entry at 17:30; it is quietest before 11:00. The observation deck is outdoor-only and closes when wind or rain is heavy. The transit day-pass is accepted at every venue listed on this page. Heavy rain is forecast for the whole day, so the outdoor terrace may be shut.
